question: If Cosec θ - cot θ = (7)/(2), then the value of cosec θ will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If cosec θ − cot θ = x, then cosec θ = (x + 1/x) ÷ 2.

Here, x = 7/2.

⇒ cosec θ = (7/2 + 2/7) ÷ 2

⇒ cosec θ = (49/14 + 4/14) ÷ 2

⇒ cosec θ = (53/14) ÷ 2 = 53/28

**∴ The correct answer is 53/28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

cosec θ − cot θ = 7/2

**Formula Used:**

cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ (cosec θ − cot θ) × (cosec θ + cot θ) = 1

⇒ (7/2) × (cosec θ + cot θ) = 1

⇒ cosec θ + cot θ = 2/7

⇒ Adding the given equation and the derived equation:

⇒ (cosec θ − cot θ) + (cosec θ + cot θ) = 7/2 + 2/7

⇒ 2 × cosec θ = (49 + 4) ÷ 14

⇒ 2 × cosec θ = 53 / 14

⇒ cosec θ = 53 / 28

**∴ The correct answer is 53/28.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Core Trigonometric Identities

sin² θ + cos² θ = 1 | sec² θ − tan² θ = 1 | cosec² θ − cot² θ = 1.

Secant & Tangent Shortcut Pattern

Similar to the relation between cosec and cot, if sec θ + tan θ = x, then sec θ − tan θ = 1/x. From this, we can easily deduce sec θ = (x + 1/x) ÷ 2.

Reciprocal Functions

cosec θ = 1 ÷ sin θ | sec θ = 1 ÷ cos θ | cot θ = 1 ÷ tan θ.
